---
name: 回声脉冲（手写测试装备）
description: 右键蓄力后推开附近生物；成功后记一次回声，恢复期间不可重复使用。
base: feather
state:
  echoes: [0, 0, 8, int]
params:
  charge: 12
  rest: 20
  radius: 6
  force: 0.4
cues:
  charging: [ongoing, 12]
  release: [result, 8]
  blocked: [failure, 8, actor]
---
function act(g,e) {
  if(e.type==='use') {
    if(!g.ready('use')) { g.cue('blocked'); return; }
    g.cooldown('use',g.p.charge+1);
    g.phase('charging');g.after('release',g.p.charge);
  }
  if(e.type==='timer'&&e.key==='release') {
    const targets=g.near(g.p.radius,8);
    if(!targets.length){g.end();g.cue('blocked');return;}
    for(const t of targets){const x=t.position.x-g.self.position.x,z=t.position.z-g.self.position.z,d=Math.hypot(x,z)||1;g.push(t.ref,x/d*g.p.force,.1,z/d*g.p.force);}
  }
  if(e.type==='receipts') {
    g.end();g.cooldown('use',g.p.rest);
    if(g.applied){g.s.echoes=Math.min(8,g.s.echoes+1);g.cue('release');}
    else g.cue('blocked');
  }
}
function draw(v,f) {
  const r=f.cue==='release'?.5+f.t*.2:Math.max(.2,1-f.t*.05);
  v.particles(f.cue==='blocked'?'cloud':'end_rod',12,i=>{const a=i*Math.PI/6+f.t*.1;return [Math.cos(a)*r,.3,Math.sin(a)*r];});
}
